gen-gf-gabarito-gf-pt-sans: Expressive from the first glance, Gabarito draws everything with one flat, fineliner-like line. PT Sans is the quieter one, its sans-serif letters approachable and professional, with c forms that read as open arcs while the heading does the showing off.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-quattrocento-sans: Pencil-like lines that never thicken or thin give Gabarito a distinctive, hand-drawn look, with terminals cut open. Quattrocento Sans keeps the text modern.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-red-hat-text: Loose, open-ended curves in Gabarito look drawn with a single nib, and every terminal is cut wide. Red Hat Text follows with pen-like sans lines.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-reddit-sans: Gabarito's terminals are cut open, so its counters seem to flow outward, as if drawn with one nib. Reddit Sans then adds a sans-serif body whose e has a wide gap at the terminal.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-rethink-sans: Loose and friendly, Gabarito looks drawn with a single nib, its counters flowing outward through open terminals. And Rethink Sans, a sans-serif with generous openings at every weight, is the part that makes the pair so approachable.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-roboto-flex: Expressive, with lines that keep their width through every turn. Roboto Flex, a sans-serif with a wide slot between the c's two ends, is the modern companion, and Gabarito is best given larger sizes.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-rosario: A plain stripe of constant ink, with terminals cut open, defines Gabarito. Rosario, a plain sans whose c never turns inward, would read in an easygoing, contemporary way over a longer passage.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-ruluko: Expressive and distinctive, Gabarito draws its t with a crossbar and stem of matching weight, as if from one nib. It earns its keep big and short.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-sansation: Distinctive in a bold way, Gabarito gives its bowls the heft of its stems and cuts its terminals open. Sansation's sans curves stay free of ink pooling.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-sarabun: Expressive and open-ended, Gabarito has tails and terminals as thick as its stems. Sarabun, a sans-serif with a wide channel into every bowl, makes the clean, approachable partner.
